about_short_description.short_description: National Finance is a financial solutions company that provides retail and corporate finance.

product.name: New Car Finance
product.description: Financing for individuals purchasing new vehicles, structured through repayment-based finance facilities.

product.name: Used Car Finance
product.description: Financing for individuals purchasing used vehicles through structured repayment-based finance facilities.

product.name: Equipment Financing
product.description: Business financing for acquiring equipment, industrial machinery, and commercial vehicles.

product.name: Debt Factoring
product.description: Receivables financing that provides businesses with liquidity against outstanding invoices, with funding of up to 85% of receivables.

product.name: Corporate Fixed Deposit
product.description: A fixed-term deposit product for companies and institutions, offering specified interest rates and payout schedules from 3 to 60 months.

product.name: Guarantee Facilities
product.description: Corporate financing facilities that help businesses meet liabilities and contractual obligations.
